thesis: The morning thesis holds: ADMA is a profitable, cash-generative biotech (morning fundamentals: quality high, dilution risk low, forward P/E 14.2) in a post-earnings uptrend above SMA20 (12.40), SMA50 (10.97) and SMA200 (10.64), and the last price of 13.15 sits inside the revised 12.90-13.25 zone on light volume (ratio 0.78), with no new news or SEC filings. Healthcare is still a leading sector in a risk-off tape. Card stop 12.40 and target 15.9 give R/R about 4.2 from the 13.08 mid entry (about 3.7 at the 13.15 last), but the target needs a break of 14.2 and R/R to 14.2 is only about 1.4 from the last price, so this stays a small Overweight rather than a Buy.
invalidation: Daily close below 12.40, which is under the 12.48 swing low and now level with the 20-day SMA, especially on rising volume.
key_risks: Broad risk-off regime (confidence 0.93, VIX 31.37 at percentile 0.995, QQQ below its 50/200-day): a market-wide flush could gap through the 12.40 stop
Pullback still in progress: three lower closes in a row (13.56, 13.34, 13.15), and the 20-day SMA has risen to 12.40, so the stop and the SMA20 are now the same level
Repeated failure at the 14.2 swing high (rejected 11/18); the 15.9 measured-move target depends on breaking it
CEO and director share sales around 2026-11-16 add supply near 14.2
Revenue growth is only about 5% YoY against net income +37%, so the earnings beat leaned on margins
